Transport.heroSubtitle: Road, rail and air—joined into one considered route

intro.kicker: Movement, made part of the journey
intro.title: The island changes outside your window.
intro.copy: We plan transport as part of the experience—not an afterthought. Take the scenic train where it matters, use a private vehicle where flexibility counts, and consider air connections when time is the priority.

rail.alt: Train crossing Sri Lanka's tea country
rail.label: Slow and scenic
rail.title: Take the train when the view is the point.
rail.copy: Hill-country rail is not simply a transfer. We can place the most memorable section inside a wider private route, with road connections before and after.

road.label: Road
road.title: Your private route, right-sized.
road.copy: From two travellers to a full touring party, choose the space that fits the journey.

fleet.title: Private car
fleet.note: The most flexible way to move at your own pace.

fleet.title: Van
fleet.note: Extra space for people, luggage and longer routes.

fleet.title: Mini bus
fleet.note: A practical balance of comfort and group capacity.

fleet.title: Coach
fleet.note: Coordinated movement for shared itineraries and equipment.

air.label: Air
air.title: Cross the island when time matters most.
air.copy: Helicopter and air-taxi options can turn a long transfer into an extraordinary aerial perspective, subject to route, weather and availability.
air.alt: Helicopter flying above Sri Lanka's coast

service.title: Planned from arrival to departure
service.cta: Tell us your party size and route. We’ll recommend the right mix.

promises.title: Airport to itinerary
promises.detail: Transfers connect directly with the route rather than sitting outside it.

promises.title: Right-sized vehicles
promises.detail: We match capacity to your party, luggage and level of comfort.

promises.title: Local route knowledge
promises.detail: Travel times, road conditions and sensible stops shape every day.

promises.title: One coordinated plan
promises.detail: Road, rail and air options can be combined into one reviewed journey.

Cricket.heroSubtitle: Tour the island with people who understand the game

opening.title: Built from inside the boundary.
opening.copy: Cricket travel asks for more than hotel rooms and a coach. Fixtures, training, grounds, recovery time and family travel all have to work together. That is where genuine playing and coaching experience changes the tour.

profile.kicker: Credibility you can build a tour around
profile.role: Former Sri Lanka Test and One Day international cricketer
profile.copy: Brendon leads Serendia’s cricket-tourism capability with more than 20 years in professional cricket and national-team coaching. He understands what a touring side needs both on the field and around it.

offerings.title: Every part of the game, connected.
offerings.copy: Choose the elements your side needs. We combine them into a staff-reviewable programme around your dates and touring party.

items.label: Tour format
items.title: School and club tours
items.description: Complete touring programmes that bring fixtures, accommodation, transport and island experiences into one practical plan.

items.label: Supporters
items.title: Spectator packages
items.description: Travel and stays arranged around tournament schedules, venue access and time to experience Sri Lanka between matches.

items.label: Match preparation
items.title: Ground and practice bookings
items.description: Match grounds and dedicated practice venues coordinated directly with suitable local clubs and facilities.

items.label: Performance
items.title: Technical coaching
items.description: Focused technical sessions, local opposition and specialist spin or fast-bowling support shaped to the touring side.

items.label: Touring party
items.title: Players and families
items.description: Accommodation options for players, staff and accompanying families, integrated with the wider touring itinerary.

spectator.title: Follow the fixture. See the island between overs.
spectator.copy: We can shape a supporter itinerary around international match dates, connecting venue days with coast, culture and wildlife.

cta.title: Bring the squad. We’ll build the tour.
cta.copy: Share your party size, approximate dates, age or playing level, and fixture interests.

intro.kicker: A B2B service, distinct from our leisure travel arrangements
intro.title: Expert advisory from acquisition to commissioning
intro.copy: One of the key strengths of Serendia Holidays is our know-how in hospitality hotel project management. We provide expert knowledge to potential investors — from the acquisition of land through to the building and commissioning of a star-class hotel.

Consultancy.servicesTitle: We advise investors in the following areas
items: To draw up a construction time plan.
Advice on the practical implications of the building plan, stores, rooms and other operations.
To advice on investment saving ideas and trends.
Handling all statutory requirement of BOI on imports.
Attending to all necessary documentation of the Inland Revenue Department in obtaining VAT, NBT and SVAT.
Obtain SVAT credit vouchers, monitoring and submitting quarterly reports.
Drawing up of procurement plan for all purchases and ensure the least is paid for the best quality items available in the market.
To ensure that the project is completed in a timely manner.
To advice on the commissioning of all equipment, plant and machinery.
Structuring and drawing up of all training and operational manuals of each department.
Advice on the execution of the total human resources plan.
To advice and draw up a total marketing plan for the proposed hotel.
To act as consultants for the hotel operational automation.
Training of staff as per the training schedule specified above.
To make timely site visits and supervision.
Provide advice and supervision on the hotel soft run.

cta.title: Considering a hotel development in Sri Lanka?
cta.copy: Talk to our project management consultancy team directly — this enquiry path is kept separate from our leisure trip planner.
